pr_title: Use legacy backing index names for data streams in mixed clusters
pr_comment:
cc: @henningandersen on the change to `ReactiveStorageDeciderService` here:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/66400/files#diff-4295fc3ce1dcb006cead63e125db2910d0c53cecf7ed2e184e4dc07bd569385aR452

I believe it's fairly trivial and can be removed after the next minor release since it is needed only in mixed clusters to accommodate the change in the naming scheme for data stream backing indices.
